query: Quebec City Canada taxi Uber fare per km base fare 2026
source: gobytaxi.com / taxifarefinder.com (Quebec City taxi and Uber rates 2026)
snippet: Uber in Quebec City: minimum fare CAD $6.50; a 5km ride costs about CAD $12.5. Traditional taxi: starting price CAD $3.5, each km priced at CAD $1.8. Quebec airport-to-downtown taxi fare is set at CAD $35.10, hourly waiting rate CAD $39.
